title: Very pretty
text: Very pretty. This is lightweight. I use it without the duvet.  It's very pretty.  4 stars because I washed it and dried it on medium heat, but the embroidery still pulled somewhat.  It's still pretty and lays pretty flat, I just wanted to be sure to point that out.  Overall, I think it's a good buy.  It is cotton so if you like a smooth look, you will need to pass an iron on it.
